_meta.notes: Tier is derived from `employees` (approximate global headcount; thresholds 100K / 10K / 1K). Subsidiaries/business units carry the PARENT's headcount and tier (e.g. Whole Foods, Zoox -> Amazon; Waymo -> Alphabet; Brooks Running, GEICO, Precision Castparts -> Berkshire Hathaway; Molex, Georgia-Pacific -> Koch), so a small unit of a giant ranks as the giant. Private-equity ownership is NOT treated as a parent (Walgreens, Staples, Inspire Brands, QTS are sized on their own). Audit/advisory networks use the global network headcount shown on Wikipedia (Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG, BDO, Grant Thornton, RSM, Baker Tilly, Crowe); the US member firm that actually employs US hires is smaller: BDO USA ~11K, RSM US ~20K, Grant Thornton LLP ~8.5K, Crowe LLP ~6K. staffing=true covers staffing agencies, recruiters (incl. 'our client' postings: Augmentis, CPS Inc., CFS, The Atlantic Group), contract-labour platforms (Alignerr, Crossover, Axiom) and job boards/aggregators (BioSpace, VetJobs, Jobright.ai, All Aviation Jobs, TalentAlly); their tier is always unknown. source=wikipedia means the headcount (and parent link, where relevant) was checked this session against the fetched Wikipedia article's infobox or body text (raw wikitext via the MediaWiki API). knowledge = model knowledge or a non-Wikipedia primary source: Ross Stores 111,000 associates (FY2025 10-K; Wikipedia's 88,100 is from 2019); Waters ~16,000 and Capstone Logistics 19,000 (their own job postings; Waters absorbed BD's Biosciences & Diagnostics unit in 2026). Honeywell Aerospace has been independent since 2026-06-29 (~40K). TikTok USDS Joint Venture is independent of ByteDance (<20% stake) and left unknown. Several aliases are generic words inherited from the input normalizer (international, foods, hub, compass, spectrum, connection, clear, box, inspire, aurora, citizens, archer, draper, harvey, acuity, axon, benchmark, providence, ust, bd, scan, wm, vast, ramp): each maps to the employer actually seen in these postings (e.g. international = International Motors, foods = US Foods, hub = Hub Group, compass = Compass real-estate) and can misfire on other firms with the same short name. 'odyssey' and 'cohere' each cover two different employers and are left unknown. Company size is not visa sponsorship: defense, government and cleared roles (U.S. Pacific Fleet, Lockheed Martin, Anduril, state/county agencies) often require US citizenship regardless of size.
